title: Stylistic Evolution and LLM Neutrality in Singlish Language
abstract: arXiv:2601.06580v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Singlish is a creole rooted in Singapore's multilingual environment that continues to evolve alongside social and technological change. We examine diachronic stylistic change across a decade of informal digital messages and ask whether Large Language Models (LLMs) can generate temporally neutral outputs approximating the stable essence of the variety. Using lexical, pragmatic, psycholinguistic, and encoder-based features, we find that stylistic separability increases with temporal distance, driven primarily by structural features such as length and complexity. Evaluated against a null distribution baseline, most LLMs fail to achieve both authenticity and temporal neutrality simultaneously, revealing a structural trade-off: models generating realistic Singlish inherit its temporal biases, while temporally neutral models produce inauthentic outputs. translated_title: 新加坡英语中的风格演变与大语言模型中立性
translated_abstract: 新加坡英语（Singlish）是一种植根于新加坡多语言环境的克里奥尔语，它随着社会和技术的变革而不断演变。我们研究了十年来非正式数字消息中的历时风格变化，并探讨大语言模型（LLMs）能否生成在时间上中立的输出，以逼近该语言变体的稳定本质。通过使用词汇、语用、心理语言学以及基于编码器的特征，我们发现风格上的可分性随时间距离的增加而增强，这主要由长度和复杂性等结构性特征所驱动。在与零分布基线进行对比评估时，大多数大语言模型无法同时实现真实性和时间中立性，揭示了一种结构性权衡：生成逼真新加坡英语的模型继承了其时间偏差，而时间中立的模型则产生不真实的输出。这些发现将时间中立性确立为评估社会语言学属性的一个诊断性指标。
tldr: 本研究揭示了新加坡英语的风格随时间演变且主要由结构性特征驱动，同时发现大语言模型存在结构性权衡——无法同时生成真实的新加坡英语和时间中立的输出。
en_tdlr: This study reveals that Singlish styles evolve over time driven mainly by structural features, and LLMs face a structural trade-off: they cannot simultaneously produce authentic Singlish and temporally neutral outputs.
